svg.title: Pipe sample evidence versus internal wakeup claims
svg.desc: A funnel shows the small set of facts established by the userspace pipe sample and the much larger set of internal wait queue and scheduler details that remain unknown without tracing. Pinned source proves possible control flow, not that the sample took it.
svg.text: Day 2 evidence: one pipe byte is not a wakeup trace
child delayed, wrote one byte, parent read it, child was reaped
sample_wait_ms = end-to-end monotonic interval · bounded completion marker
a pipe operation waited and later completed
timing includes timer + scheduling + pipe + interference

g.text: ? direct rq activation vs remote wake list

svg.text: High latency alone does not prove a lost wakeup; one fast sample does not prove race freedom.
Pinned source: proves the 6.12 ordering and alternatives · runtime branch taken: unknown without event evidence
